children.value: > Fact From Story The Epoch Times was early to lay blame on China for Covid — labeling it the “CCP Virus” in its coverage.
> > Fact From Story The Epoch Times became a reliable source for misinformation around Covid, its treatments and the vaccines.

> > Fact From Story China’s documented handling of the virus, including withholding information from researchers, a crackdown on whistleblowers and an authoritarian public health response, added credibility to The Epoch Times’ unproven claims.
> > Commonsense Knowledge People are more likely to believe claims if there is some evidence that supports them.
> Fact From Story As The Epoch Times’ marketing strategy shifted, so did the content — and by 2020, it became a megaphone for the U.S.’s most extreme right-wing stories.
> Commonsense Knowledge Media companies often shift their content to align with their marketing strategies.
